runtime.policy_context: A single reusable resource class (for example memory units) is managed with Dijkstra's banker's algorithm: a state is safe when there exists an ordering of the remaining processes such that each process's remaining need can be covered by currently available units plus the units released by processes finished earlier. A request is granted only if the resulting state is still safe.
